research_question: Does v6 complete-program replay reproduce the path and ownership semantics of the independent EnvBench Official evaluator closely enough to support a target-state replay claim?

four_cell_counterfactual.probe: Run git status as container root in the mounted repository.
four_cell_counterfactual.causal_result: Ownership, not path layout, caused the observed mflowgen Git failure. Path layout remains an independent systematic state mismatch that may affect path-sensitive programs.

scope_assessment.reason: The divergent path and Linux ownership transformations are unconditional provider and evaluator behaviors, so every Linux replay differs from Official on these state dimensions even when a particular program is insensitive to them.
scope_assessment.agenthub_additional_difference: Docker Desktop does not apply the Linux chown translation, while Official is evaluated on Spark Linux. AgentHub replay therefore has a separate host/runtime ownership semantic from Official.

replay_history.remaining_win: The first replay ended in a dependency-download timeout; the second increased pip timeout from 30 to 180 seconds and passed. No prior B-exclusive win contains a semantic verifier failure followed by a successful repair.

effect_on_previous_v6_wins.interpretation: The five terminal wins still show that the bundled B procedure produced Official-passing programs where two independent free-Agent controls did not. They do not isolate replay feedback as the cause, and v6 must not call its replay an Official target-state reproduction.

protocol_versioning_decision.required_next_version: A fidelity-corrected replay changes the treatment implementation and must be preregistered as a new version before counted runs.
protocol_versioning_decision.reason: Changing mount path or ownership changes which candidate failures the Agent can observe and repair, so it changes the causal treatment rather than merely repairing result bookkeeping.

scientific_decision.allowed_closure: Already-generated unrelated A1 programs may receive their frozen postepisode Official evaluation.
scientific_decision.next_minimal_high_information_validation: Implement an Official-faithful replay provider in a new version, then run a small preregistered paired set containing at least one ownership-sensitive consumed case and cases whose first replay returns a semantic failure. Promotion requires free Agent terminal failure and corrected replay treatment Official Pass.

alternative_explanations: The bundled B prompt or requirement to obtain certification may make the Agent produce a more complete first candidate even when replay feedback contributes no repair.
The additional executable attempt may improve reliability without semantic feedback.
Replay success can be a false positive when the replay container normalizes away an Official failure state.
safeguard_effect: No new hash, frozen contract, gate, candidate restriction, or case-specific repair was introduced.
